issue.title: Escalation: Checkout occasionally fails when customers apply a...

summary: Checkout occasionally fails when customers apply a discount code. We cannot consistently reproduce it, but customers are complaining about 500 errors on the checkout page.
facts: Customer reported issue: Checkout occasionally fails when customers apply a discount code. We cannot consistently reproduce it, but customers are complaining about 500 errors on the checkout page.
Application error found: Failed to apply discount: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'percentage')
observations: Found 1 sample requests correlating with the issue.
hypotheses: Recent change 'Refactor discount calculation logic' might be related to the issue.

steps: Send POST to POST /api/v1/checkout with payload: {"cart_id": "cart_9921", "discount_code": "SAVE20", "payment_method": "credit_card"}
reproduction.observed: Checkout fails with HTTP 500. Matches reported issue.

evidence.observation: Failed to apply discount: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'percentage')
Updated the discount service to support fixed amount discounts. May have changed the payload structure for percentage discounts.

recommended_next_steps: Engineering needs to fix the discount calculation logic for percentage discounts.
